svg.title: Stock keyboard layout comparison: YIVU Borne and Lofree Flow Lite84
svg.desc: The split, column-staggered 60-control Borne is above the conventional 84-key ANSI Lofree Flow Lite84. All visible labels reproduce the stock keycap legends.
